branding_kit.label: Branding Kit
branding_kit.summary: A concise identity starter package covering logo, stationery and essential brand assets.
terms: 50% balance after final approval before source handover

website.label: Website Design & Development
website.summary: Custom website design and development with a structured CMS-backed build, responsive layouts and launch support.
deliverables: Headless CMS architecture with Next.js and WordPress CMS
Responsive desktop, tablet and mobile layouts
Enquiry forms and basic lead capture
Core modules such as news, blogs, testimonials, gallery and FAQ when selected
pricingTable: Headless CMS Architecture with Next.js SSR and MySQL Integration
Module Development: News/Events, Blogs, Testimonials, Gallery, FAQ

amc.label: Annual Website Maintenance
amc.summary: Ongoing website maintenance for updates, uptime checks, minor fixes, form checks and routine technical support.
deliverables: Security and plugin/theme updates where applicable
terms: Major design/development changes are billed separately

hosting.label: Website Hosting
hosting.summary: Managed hosting support aligned with the website stack and expected traffic profile.
deliverables: Backup coordination where available in the plan
terms: Third-party hosting/provider charges are payable as applicable

seo.label: Search Engine Optimization
seo.summary: SEO planning, on-page recommendations, off-page activity, reporting and technical coordination.
deliverables: Technical SEO support such as redirects, sitemap, robots.txt and tracking coordination
terms: SEO results depend on competition, search changes, content, technical access and approval speed

ppc.label: Performance Marketing
ppc.summary: Google and Meta campaign planning, execution, optimization and reporting for lead generation, reach or engagement objectives.
deliverables: Google Search campaign setup when selected
pricingTable: 20% of media spend or minimum retainer
terms: Media spends are payable in advance
Platform billing, taxes and card charges are separate where applicable

smm.label: Social Media Management
smm.summary: Monthly social media planning, content calendar, static posts, reels coordination, page management and reporting.
deliverables: Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn page management as scoped
Reel shooting and editing when selected
terms: Additional platforms and creatives are billed separately

clientResponsibilities: Timely approvals, feedback and access sharing
Brand guidelines, product/service inputs and factual content
Legal, regulatory and claim approvals from the client side
Access to domain, hosting, CMS, analytics, ad accounts or social handles where required
policies: Commercials are exclusive of GST unless stated otherwise.
Third-party tools, stock assets, media spends, hosting, domain, plugin and platform charges are billed separately unless included in the commercial table.
Major scope additions, extra pages, extra creative routes, extra platforms, new modules and urgent work outside the agreed scope may be quoted separately.
Final ownership of approved creative/source assets transfers after full payment, subject to third-party license terms.
No guaranteed SEO ranking, lead volume, sales conversion or platform performance is promised because these depend on market, competition, budgets, approvals and platform behavior.
